default.description: What the renderer is allowed to reach. Parley's own commands (pane_open, pane_write, ...) are not listed because Tauri does not gate commands the app itself defines — only the core plugins. `core:default` is here for one of them: the event plugin. Without it `listen()` is denied, and a denied listen is a rejected promise nobody awaited: invoke keeps working, panes keep spawning, Rust keeps emitting, and the terminal stays blank with no error anywhere. That cost an afternoon.
